summary: Keys saved under Integrations now survive website updates, and saving a key no longer fails after an update.
detailed_changes: Each website update was replacing the site's encryption key, so keys saved under Admin → Settings → Integrations could no longer be read afterwards and everyone was signed out. Updates now keep the existing key (#637).
Saving a replacement for a key that could no longer be read showed an error page. It now replaces the old value (#637).
affected_areas: User groups affected: super admins (integration keys); everyone stays signed in across updates
Internal impact: deploy/cloudron-activate.sh, IntegrationSecrets; the Mailgun keys under Integrations need entering once more
